subject: ventures/fdr-multiple-testing
professional: a senior biostatistician who adjusts genomics and clinical-endpoint p-values; first checks: do BH/BY/Holm/Hochberg adjusted p-values match R p.adjust / statsmodels including ties and exact 0s and 1s, is the BKY stage-2 level q/(1+q) * m/m0 (not q * m/m0), is Storey's pi0 the fixed-lambda estimator with q = pi0 * BH, does dropping NA rows shrink m silently, are the dependence assumptions stated per method, and are LORD++/SAFFRON levels the papers' formulas

evidence.correctness: Fresh list not in the author's eval set: 504 one-sided p-values (500 z-tests, 60 shifted by 3, rounded to 4 dp for ties, plus 0, 1, 1, 1e-12), seed 7681 (/tmp/claude-0/audit-fdr/gen.py). `node js.mjs && python3.13 -I cmp.py` against statsmodels 0.15.0 multipletests: Bonferroni, Holm, Hochberg max |diff| 0, Sidak 1.1e-16, BH 1.1e-16, BY 2.2e-16; fdr_tsbky rejections identical at 0.01/0.05/0.1/0.2 (22/42/46/50). Storey pi0 (0.82937) and q-values equal to my own implementation of Storey-Tibshirani 2003 Remark B (diff 0). Online rules re-implemented by me from the LOND/LORD++/SAFFRON formulas (not the author's eval/online_reference.py): every level within 5e-17, rejections LOND 27, LORD++ 39, SAFFRON 63, identical. Hand: BH-1995 example H4 BH 15*0.0095/4=0.0356, Holm 12*0.0095=0.114, BY H1 0.0015*H(15)=0.00498, pi0 4/7.5=0.533: all match `node cli.mjs data/bh1995.csv`. The gamma-sum side finding (0.9763) recomputed: partial sum to 1e7 0.5774 + tail 2c e^-a(a^3+3a^2+6a+6) 0.3989. Not a 4: the agent/JS values path turns null and '' into p = 0 (Number(null) === 0), so a missing value becomes a discovery: analyze({values:[0.01,null,0.5]}) gives m=3, dropped 0, Storey keeps 3; and a comma-decimal list '0,1 0,01 0,001' splits into six values, three of them p=0, all 'kept'.
evidence.completeness: Claimed features run end to end: eight batch methods with adjusted values (CLI table and --csv), BKY stage-1 count and stage-2 level (8, 0.0649 on the example, README table matches), Storey pi0 curve and histogram in the JSON, e-BH (`--kind e`), online LORD++/SAFFRON/LOND/spending (`node cli.mjs data/online-stream.csv --online` gives 17/27/11/7 and batch BH 38, as README), agent tool call via platform/agents/tools.mjs, live page https://marisstella.app/fdr-multiple-testing/ 200 with online mode (53 matches for online|saffron), served canonical on marisstella.app, served llms.txt current (lists online FDR). No stubs or TODOs found; 'Not modelled' list in README is explicit.
evidence.verification: `cd ventures/fdr-multiple-testing && node --test '*.test.mjs'`: 50 tests, 50 pass, 2.0 s. Tests check every adjusted value against a committed statsmodels reference (eval/reference.json) to 1e-12 and online levels against a separate Python implementation. Eight seeded mutants via platform/ci/quality_mutate.py: 3 caught (BKY stage-2 uses alpha instead of alpha/(1+alpha); p=0 rejected as invalid; SAFFRON candidate clock removed), 5 survived: rejection `<= alpha` -> `< alpha` (engine.mjs:386), BH cut-off `<=` -> `<` (engine.mjs:404), LORD++ wealth earning `alpha - w0` -> `alpha` on the first discovery (online.mjs:103, wealth is shown to users), small-m pi0 warning threshold 100 -> 10 (engine.mjs:424), ragged-row check `!==` -> `<` (engine.mjs:178). The core numeric paths are well guarded; the boundaries, displayed wealth and parser are not.
evidence.craft: Read engine.mjs (488 lines), online.mjs (149), cli.mjs, the page script (index.html:269+), eval/reference.py. Pure functions, one engine shared by page, CLI and agent tools (the page imports ./engine.mjs, no copy), stable sorts, Sidak via expm1/log1p, PAPERS export documents deviations per method. Defects: the `values` array path uses Number() without a missing-value check (engine.mjs:301), unlike the CSV path; the bare-list tokenizer splits on commas (engine.mjs:163) so comma-decimal locales are misread and the error, when one appears, names a fragment ('#4 is 2'); `by_` helper shadows-in-name the BY method, minor.
evidence.claims: Checked: 'checked against statsmodels 0.15.0 ... to 1e-12' (engine.test.mjs:18 runs against eval/reference.json; I reproduced on new data), BH-1995 counts 3/4/8 and 0.0649 (cli output), online example counts 17/27/11/7/38 (cli output), simulation table rows (eval/simulation.json: Holm fdr 0.0049, fwer 0.0475, power 0.084 as README), gamma sum 0.9763 and partial sum to 1e6 0.52 (recomputed 0.5217), 'nothing uploaded' (page script has no fetch; usage local only), disclaimer in index.html:62,258 and README 'No warranty'. data/SOURCE.md honestly states the 1995 values were read from statsmodels tests, not the paper. Not verified: 'c = 0.07720838, the default of the online-fdr Python package' (package not installed here; README says it was read, not run). No overclaim found.
evidence.fitness: Walked a biostatistician's job: paste a gene-level CSV (gene,pvalue), pick BH at 0.05, read adjusted values and the kept list, download CSV, compare BY under arbitrary dependence and Storey q-values with a pi0 curve and small-m warning. Works in under a minute in the page and CLI; NA rows are dropped with an explicit warning that m shrinks. Gaps a professional hits: Hommel and weighted/grouped (IHW) procedures absent; Storey pi0 is the fixed-lambda estimator, not qvalue's default smoother/bootstrap, so q-values will not match the qvalue package's defaults (disclosed); no local FDR.
evidence.domain: Compared against Benjamini-Hochberg 1995, Benjamini-Yekutieli 2001, BKY 2006 (stage-2 q' m/m0 with q'=q/(1+q): matches), Storey 2002 / Storey-Tibshirani 2003 (pi0(lambda) = #{p>lambda}/(m(1-lambda)); qvalue uses p >= lambda, differs only at ties exactly at lambda), Wang-Ramdas 2022 e-BH, Javanmard-Montanari 2018, Ramdas et al. 2017/2018. Assumptions per method are stated correctly (BH PRDS, BY any, Holm any, Hochberg/Sidak positive dependence, BKY independence). Departures: fixed-lambda pi0 only; LORD gamma constant sums to 0.976 (conservative, disclosed).

verdict: Meets the bar. On a fresh 504-test list with ties, exact 0s and 1s, every adjusted p-value from Bonferroni, Sidak, Holm, Hochberg, BH and BY matches statsmodels 0.15.0 within 2.2e-16, two-stage BKY rejections match fdr_tsbky at four levels, and Storey q-values and the LOND/LORD++/SAFFRON levels match my own implementations from the papers to 5e-17; the BH-1995 example matches hand arithmetic, and the README's gamma-sum side finding recomputes to 0.9763. 50 tests pass and guard the numeric core (3 of 3 core mutants caught), but 5 of 8 mutants survive on boundaries, the displayed LORD++ wealth and the parser. The worst defect is input handling on the values-array path: null or '' becomes p = 0 and is reported as a discovery, which an agent passing NA as null would act on. Claims are backed and limits disclosed; a biostatistician could sign off for BH/BY/Holm work, noting fixed-lambda pi0 and no Hommel or weighted procedures.
